summary: Tested new opt-in PPh21 feature (pph21_active per employee) end-to-end. Backend: 5/6 pytest cases pass; verified baseline (all inactive → total_pph21=0, slips=[] for 2026-07), enable Abidin via PUT /api/hr/employees/{id} persists (checkbox + PTKP K/1), /api/hr/pph21 for 2026-07 then returns exactly 1 slip = Abidin, TER category B, rate 6%, pph21 900,000; payroll slip net still equals gross - kasbon (nett method preserved). Frontend: login as admin/admin123, opened Abidin edit modal, verified data-testid=emp-pph21-active exists next to emp-ptkp-status, toggled on + PTKP K/1, Simpan, reopened modal → checkbox stayed checked and PTKP persisted. /arc/hr/pph21 page renders period 2026-07 with total Rp 900.000 status BELUM DIBAYAR, expand row shows Abidin K/1 TER B 6% 15,000,000 → 900,000, 'Bayar PPh21' button present. Reverted Abidin pph21_active=false at end; baseline retest confirms 0 slips again.

minor.issue: Legacy employee documents whose Mongo doc lacks the pph21_active key have the field omitted from the response instead of defaulted to false. Frontend tolerates this via `!!form.pph21_active`, but the API response schema is inconsistent across employees. Suggest projecting `pph21_active: bool(doc.get('pph21_active', False))` in the serializer so all rows expose the field.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Normalize GET /api/hr/employees response so pph21_active is always present (default false) even for legacy documents to keep the API schema uniform.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py list employees endpoint should apply a default {pph21_active: False} when serializing legacy Mongo docs to keep API responses consistent with the EmployeeIn model.
seed_data_creation: None. Temporarily toggled Abidin pph21_active + PTKP K/1 for testing then reverted (pph21_active=false, PTKP kept at K/1 which was its pre-existing value).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature is fully working. Baseline at 2026-07 has 0 PPh21 slips (all employees inactive). Enabling any employee via PUT /api/hr/employees/{id} with pph21_active=true + valid PTKP includes them in /api/hr/pph21 with TER-computed pph21 and does not touch payroll `net` (nett method). UI checkbox data-testid=emp-pph21-active in the employee edit modal (Kepegawaian section) works. Backend legacy-doc response omits the pph21_active key when absent — minor, not blocking.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — feature works as specified. Sole minor gap: the employees list endpoint does not project a default value for pph21_active when the underlying Mongo document was created before this field existed, so some employee records omit the key in the API response.
